title: Drifter Desserts Vanilla Custard 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Vanilla Custard by Drifter Desserts delivers the comforting flavour of classic Vanilla Custard, with its silky-sweet taste and mellow creaminess. Each puff brings the familiar notes of smooth Vanilla layered over a rich, velvety custard base for a vape that captures the essence of a timeless dessert favourite. Crafted with a balanced 50VG/50PG blend, this Nic Salt e-liquid ensures clear flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping, it pairs perfectly with low-powered starter kits, pod vapes, and refillable vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers flexible nicotine options to suit different preferences. Drifter Desserts is a premium collection from Juice Sauz, created in the UK and inspired by indulgent sweet treats. With carefully blended profiles that showcase authentic dessert flavours, the range provides a satisfying choice for vapers looking for something rich, smooth, and flavour-focused. This liquid is perfect for refillable vape and vape starter kit users.
